name: IcyCache
description: Universal multi-upstream LLM gateway with a local cache — FastAPI + SQLite, Aho-Corasick normalization (1111 rules), 11 MCP tools, metrics dashboard. 100% CPU, 0 paid API. I SEE CACHE, I BURN CACHE.

environmentVariables.name: ICYCACHE_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the gateway config file. Defaults to the packaged config.

environmentVariables.name: ICYCACHE_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the cache database. Defaults to <data dir>/db/cache.db.

environmentVariables.name: ICYCACHE_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Data directory for db/ and logs/. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%/IcyCache when installed.
